description: NL-01 is the primary Regional Transport Office for Kohima, the capital city of Nagaland. It serves as the main administrative hub for vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permit issuance for the Kohima district and its surrounding blocks.
address: Regional Transport Office, New Capital Complex, Secretariat, Kohima, Nagaland

description: The NL-02 RTO office serves the Mokokchung district in Nagaland, acting as a primary hub for vehicle registration and driver licensing. It plays a critical role in managing transport regulations and road safety within one of the oldest and most significant cultural districts of the state.

The NL-03 District Transport Office (DTO) serves as the primary motor vehicle regulatory body for the Tuensang district in Nagaland. It handles duties such as vehicle registration, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing transportation safety standards in one of Nagaland's most populous eastern districts.
address: Near Government High School, Tuensang, Nagaland

description: NL-04 is the official Regional Transport Office for the Mon district in Nagaland. This District Transport Office (DTO) is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection within the border district primarily inhabited by the Konyak Naga tribe.

NL-05 is the District Transport Office (DTO) for Wokha, Nagaland. It is responsible for all regional vehicle registrations, driver licensing, and traffic regulation enforcement within the Wokha district.
address: District Transport Office, Near DC Office Complex, Wokha, Nagaland

description: NL-06 is the official code for the District Transport Office (DTO) of Zunheboto in Nagaland. This office is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection within the Zunheboto district.
address: District Transport Office (DTO), Near Public Ground, Zunheboto, Nagaland

description: The NL-07 RTO serves as the District Transport Office for Dimapur, the commercial capital and most populous city of Nagaland. It is responsible for managing vehicle registrations, road tax collection, and the issuance of driving licenses for the district which acts as a major transport hub for the Northeast region.
address: District Transport Office, 2 1/2 Mile, NH-39, Dimapur, Nagaland

description: The NL-08 RTO is the District Transport Office (DTO) located in Phek, Nagaland. It is responsible for motor vehicle registration, issuing driving licenses, and implementing transport laws across the Phek district.
address: District Transport Office, Motor Vehicles Department, Phek, Nagaland

description: NL-10 is a specialized RTO code in Nagaland designated exclusively for the registration of Government Non-Transport (private) vehicles. It is managed by the Regional Transport Office in Kohima and serves the state's official government fleet rather than the general public.
address: Commissionerate of Motor Vehicles Department, Government of Nagaland, New Capital Complex, Kohima, Nagaland
